_doc: A book that cannot be opened (audit AUD-009): actions on it are refused, nothing crashes, HOME works.

action.user.reader.next_page.why: the NEXT key and the right-side tap reached the action and were refused

action.user.reader.prev_page.why: the PREV key reached the action and was refused

reader.page_turns.why: there is no page to turn to

ui.open_to_stable_ms.count.why: the shelf and the book screen (with its message) opened

ui.action_to_visible_ms.FLASH_UI.count.why: HOME brought the home screen back
